outcome: CLI prints repository-relative paths so agents cannot copy a machine-local absolute path from command output
criteria: inkan init prints Initialized Inkan in . or Already initialized Inkan in . and does not print a machine-local absolute path
inkan decision add prints .inkan/decisions/<id>-<slug>.md and does not print a machine-local absolute path
inkan skill install default and --claude print a repository-relative destination and do not print a machine-local absolute path
doctor and outcome-read error labels name files under .inkan/ with repository-relative paths, never a machine-local absolute path

note: CLI init prints Initialized/Already initialized Inkan in . ; decision add prints .inkan/decisions/<id>-<slug>.md; skill install prints .agents/skills/use-inkan, .claude/skills/use-inkan, or a cwd-relative --target path. doctor and outcome-read error labels use .inkan/outcomes/<id>.jsonl and .inkan/decisions/<name>. Library file handles stay absolute. 110 unit tests pass.
